_about: Final and near-final pre-election demographic polling for the 2022 federal election, assembled from the lanes in .build/analysis/election-demographics (agent-scraped lane JSONs; every figure traceable to a verbatim source saved under src/). Shares are the houses' printed figures, re-based to decided voters where a printed undecided share existed (und kept on the wave). Non-standard keys besides alp/lnp/grn/onp/oth: pup, sample, trend2pp, nxt, kap, uap, note, ind, caution. See provenance for per-house sources; gaps record what was probed and not found. Fieldwork dates/samples are null where the surviving copies don't carry them.
